Yamada Ryou.... Kessoku Band's bassist.
When I was 23 years old, in addition to
the pain of being in debt, I lost my will
to live and planned to commit suicide by
charcoal fire.
虹夏立绘3
Nijika-L. I'm the angel in charge of the
Shimokitazawa area. Once, without God's
permission, I changed a person's fate for
their reincarnation.
As punishment, I was sent to live on Earth
as a human.
小虹立绘1
Ijichi Nijika...... Kessoku Band's drummer.
When I was 9 years old, my mother died,
and I started living with just my
older sister.
When I was 19, I was killed by a car
when I ran out to save a cat on the
street.

Refrigerator:
Hello, I’m the Refrigerator. I was in charge
of the production of this game and its CGs.
Refrigerator:
This will be long, but in order to tell
you the story behind the scenes, would you
allow me to take some of your time?
Yes
No
Yes
Refrigerator:
First and foremost, playing this game and
arriving at an ending, no matter which one it
may be, this is the choice of fate! Thank you!
Refrigerator:
“Fate”..... I unconsciously ended up
emphasizing these words. As you may realize,
we are powerless in the face of time.
Refrigerator:
“Fate” in this work, became a singular
character “God”. That is how we designed them.
Refrigerator:
For all of this story’s beginnings and endings,
you may have thought that it was as if God had
manipulated things.
Refrigerator:
But actually, it was the ending that our two
protagonists chose themselves.
Refrigerator:
“Shimokitazawa” for example, even if there
had not been a test, she would have still
chosen to run out in front of that car....
Refrigerator:
...When I played RPGs, games with multiple endings,
particularly ones where a character’s survival
or death could be influenced, was something I hated.
Refrigerator:
Each and every of my choices influenced a
character’s fate, and sometimes even their
life. It was like entrusting them into my hands.
Refrigerator:
I hate that.... When I learned that my choices
were wrong afterwards, it made me very sad.
Refrigerator:
Guilt ate at me, knowing that I had
basically killed this character.
Refrigerator:
But when I came onto the side of creating
games, as if it were inevitable, we made
a setting where there were multiple endings.
Refrigerator:
Even if you ended at a Normal End, even
if you found the path to reach the Happy
End, both choices have a meaning to them.
Refrigerator:
HfD’s Episode 1 had a suspenseful-like beginning,
but in reality, from the beginning and end, it
had become a serious (?) kind of game.
Refrigerator:
The plot about Ryou and "Shimokitazawa" having to
reincarnate 100 people, from the beginning when we
were drafting the scenario, was the most important.
Refrigerator:
Since the release of Episode 1, we were able to
spend so, so much time together with everyone in
this month that was short and yet so long.
Refrigerator:
If we must discuss about the past,
to me, the past is something that should not be
changed. This is the perception that I have.
Refrigerator:
Like how Bocchi, after being discharged from the
hospital, no longer wished to find Nijika,
and walked on a normal path of life with Kita...
Refrigerator:
Alright, that’s enough with the game talk.
Finally, let's get onto the real issue at
hand.
Refrigerator:
Once more, to everyone who played this game,
I sincerely thank you all.
Refrigerator:
To my fans who are following me on my timeline,
how many "fake" RPGs have you noticed me
releasing in these past 1 to 2 years?
Refrigerator:
Yes, a fake RPG.... In other words, a game
that is given an initial release and then
left untouched.
Refrigerator:
I am an impatient perfectionist. If I think
about making a complete RPG, I will spend an
inordinately absurd amount of time on it.
Refrigerator:
Frankly speaking, that applied to HfD, too.
When we had released Episode 1, instead of finalizing
it, I wanted to focus on making the other artworks...
Refrigerator:
But what surprised me was not just how many
friends came to play it...
Refrigerator:
But also how videos were made on it, how it was
translated into JP, and how it even got fanworks
made for it...
Refrigerator:
Because of that, a huge sense of responsibility
was born. That "I have to complete this story."
Refrigerator:
And the result of that was, just as you see.
Refrigerator:
The play time should be around 2 hours, which
is short.... Well, I think 2 hours is already
pretty good.
Refrigerator:
I'm sure that if it wasn't for everyone’s
support... I don't think we could have done
this.
Refrigerator:
Altogether, to the people who played this game,
and to the people who worked together to find
bugs in the Beta version, I sincerely thank you!!
Refrigerator:
Greyhound and Dust, I also thank you very
much for the wonderful illustrations!!
Refrigerator:
Like I mentioned earlier, I'm an impatient
person, so rather than a request, I "forced"
them to work.
Refrigerator:
I will apologize here. (dogeza)
Refrigerator:
In such a short time period, they produced
such wonderful drawings for me. You two are
seriously amazing! I am quietly crying.
Refrigerator:
They told me that we should deliver a "perfect
game", but I wasn't sure if we could manage
to do that.
Refrigerator:
In any case, if something from this long tale
could remain in your heart, then there is no
greater joy that I could have.
Refrigerator:
And with that, I shall end here.
Refrigerator:
From now on, I shall live on as a box for
collecting disused goods.

Suicide Note
If you are reading this letter, then I am no
longer in this world, am I? If you're asking
where I am, I believe that I am surely in Hell.
If you were to ask me why I chose to end
my life, this is how I would answer:
"I'm tired. Everything is boring."
That's all.
To all my creditors, please let them know that I
have passed all my savings to my friend Kita Ikuyo.
I have provided her contact information at the end.
If this is still not enough, please contact my parents.
Mama, Papa, I'm sorry.
In these 23 years, I have been a bad daughter.
Your excessive helicoptering was troublesome...
So I decided to learn how to play the bass that
was in the manga that my friend recommended me.
Picking up the bass, joining a band, and
dropping out of university, all of these things
were just my whims.
...... I can't change the past, so I won't talk about
it much. In the first place, I wasn't disappointed
with my life. Even though I was buried in debt for
these past 2 to 3 years, I was satisfied.
There's just one thing. There's something
that I just can't understand no matter what I
do, so I’ll write it down here.
This is something that I've never told anyone
about, so I’m not thinking about finding the
answer to it.
I just... thought that I wanted to leave a
record and write about it.
There was a night when I was 19 years old....
I remember that it was pouring rain, but
whether I was drinking alcohol or not, I
don't remember.
What I remember was standing in front of
Ijichi Seika’s house carrying stuff for a
sleepover, and when all of the sudden, I
started crying.
Ijichi Seika is the owner of the livehouse
STARRY. The band I used to be part of,
“Kessoku Band”, used to perform there a lot.
After I quit the band, I hadn’t met her
once, and before that I wasn’t really that
close to her either.
No matter what I did, I couldn't understand.
1. Why did I know where she lived?
2. Why had I prepared to stay over at her place?
3. Why was I crying?
After she took me all the way back home in
my state of confusion, I frantically tried
to remember what had happened. But no matter
what I did, I couldn't remember.
My life after that, to me, was miserable.
My memories had been erased like the words
written on a sandy beach.
No matter how deeply the words were carved into
the floor, eventually the waves would crash,
leaving not even a trace.
This might be some crazy thinking... But in my
hazy memories as a student, I...
I felt like there was someone that existed there.
And on that day in my 19th year of life,
that person was the one who disappeared...
is what I thought.
Speaking of which, Bocchi... Gotou Hitori
may have gone crazy starting from that year.
Please forgive me for taking her from this
world along with me. This is also just a
decision I made on my own. I couldn’t stand
seeing Bocchi looking like a husk......
Bocchi already seemed like she was dead.
At this rate, even if she were to continue
living, nothing would change for her, would it?
....That was what I believed.
Everyday, she chased after an invisible
imaginary friend, showed strange aggression
towards Kessoku Band’s drummer, and was always
terribly and irrationally arguing with Ikuyo....
She stopped standing on the stage, which had
been her reason for living. She even closed
her Guitar Hero account. This wasn’t Bocchi,
or at least, this wasn’t the Bocchi that I knew.
At this rate, I feared what would become of
Bocchi. That was why, I gave her a ticket
to journey with me to the afterlife.
.....And what happened after that, everyone
should know what went down.
In my lifetime, I have made a lot of lies.
I've probably never said anything sincere.
But even so, the last thing I wish to say is,
“I’m sorry.”
To myself, to everyone, these words are my
true thoughts.
And with that, I end it here.
I don’t wish for things like everyone to
remember the past for me, or for me to be
reborn again.
I will end with the words of a Chinese poet, Sū Shì:
“Life is but a journey.
I, too, am only a passerby.”
And in the end, I am just another boring human.
....... Goodbye.
Yamada Ryou
Reiwa Some Year, Some Month, Some Day.
In my house.
